maria (PM): Heads-up: sketching the observability roadmap for next quarter. Goal: 1) concise dashboards for cost + error, 2) tracing hooks on hot routes, 3) runbookable regressions + alerts. Can we scope a minimal launch that supports customer rollouts? Thoughts, owners, and must-have acceptance criteria please.

alex (Eng): I think we should aim for: dashboard templates (per-model, per-route), cost breakdown by token/route, trace sampling for high-latency requests, and error rollup with attribution. Key tradeoff: telemetry ingestion cost vs retention.

jasper (SRE): Agree. Must-have: SLO delta alerting and an automated fallback path (model downgrade) in case of regression. Also need sampling knobs to control costs.

kevin (Design): For dashboards, shipping a small set of composable widgets is better than a monolith. I’ll mock a panel for cost-per-1k tokens and a trace waterfall. Will share by EOD.

emily (Data): We’ll need a canonical schema for events: route, model_version, cpu_ms, gpu_ms, token_count, latency_p50/p90/p99, error_code, user_tier. I’ll draft and share mapping.

linda (Support): Customer ask from BetaCorp: want per-API-key cost dashboards and email alerts when cost > threshold. Also need CSV export for finance teams.

maria (PM): Proposed launch cuts if we hit the timebox: 1) reduce retention from 90d -> 30d, 2) postpone ad-hoc query UI, 3) sample traces only on p90+ or error. Accept criteria: dashboards show cost + error per-route, tracing hooks emit the schema, and at least one customer (BetaCorp) can view per-key dashboard.

alex (Eng): Action items: Alex - dashboard backend + query endpoints. Jasper - tracing hooks + sampling controls. Emily - event schema + backfills. Kevin - dashboard UX. Linda - BetaCorp acceptance test plan. I’ll own rollout + canary.

jasper (SRE): We also need an automated canary policy. Suggest: 5% traffic to new telemetry pipeline, run 48h, monitor ingestion CPU and cost delta < 15%. If anomaly, auto-rollback.

maria (PM): Can we put a minimal QA checklist?

kevin (Design): ```
QA checklist:
- Verify default dashboard loads within 2s
- Cost card shows per-route and per-model split
- Trace link opens full span in trace viewer
- Alert fires on SLO delta > 5%
```

alex (Eng): `deploy canary: ./deploy --canary 5% --watch 48h`

alex (Eng): I’ll add metrics to the deploy dashboard.

linda (Support): I’ll coordinate a BetaCorp demo next Wednesday morning PST.

maria (PM): One more negotiation point: ops asked that retention be configurable per-customer. If that increases scope we cut advanced exports. Votes?

jasper (SRE): :thumbsup: for per-customer retention default configurable but behind feature flag.

emily (Data): Note on schema: include optional `route_tags` list to support customer grouping.

maria (PM): Thanks. I’ll synthesize these into a narrow scope doc and post a PR on the roadmap board. Final ask: owners confirm by EOD so I can lock scope.
